description: Enterprise-grade data modeling, governance, and AI-safe rules for relational, NoSQL, caching, migrations, performance, security, and database programmability

rules.description: Every table must have a primary key
rules.message: Every table must have a PRIMARY KEY defined
rules.design_check: Does the design explicitly define a primary key for every proposed table? If any table lacks a primary key specification, BLOCK.

rules.description: Avoid ENUM columns - use lookup tables instead
rules.message: Avoid ENUM columns - use lookup tables for better maintainability
rules.design_check: Does the design use ENUM types anywhere? If so, replace with a lookup table (lkp_ prefix) referenced via FK. BLOCK on any ENUM in schema design.

design_patterns.description: Database design patterns and best practices

rules.description: Use polymorphic design for shared entities like contacts and addresses
rules.message: Use polymorphic design - create shared tables (contacts, addresses) with bridge tables instead of duplicating for each entity (e.g., contacts + customer_contacts bridge)
rules.design_check: Does the design duplicate contact/address tables per entity (e.g., customer_address, vendor_address)? If so, propose a shared polymorphic table with a bridge. BLOCK on duplicated entity-specific contact/address tables.

rules.description: Table names should be snake_case and plural
rules.message: Table names should be snake_case (e.g., user_profiles not UserProfiles)
rules.design_check: Are all proposed table names written in snake_case plural form (e.g., vehicle_listings, market_valuations)? Flag any PascalCase or camelCase table names.

rules.description: Column names should be snake_case
rules.message: Column names should be snake_case (e.g., created_at not createdAt)
rules.design_check: Are all proposed column names in snake_case (e.g., created_at, tenant_id, vehicle_make)? Flag any camelCase column names.

rules.description: Lookup tables must be prefixed with lkp_
rules.message: Lookup/reference tables must be prefixed with 'lkp_' (e.g., lkp_order_status, lkp_user_roles)
rules.design_check: Do ALL lookup/reference tables in the design use the lkp_ prefix? Check for any table representing status, type, category, role, state, priority, or level values that does NOT start with lkp_. BLOCK if any such table lacks the prefix.

rules.description: ARRAY columns forbidden in relational schemas
rules.message: ARRAY columns are forbidden in relational schemas - use junction tables
rules.design_check: Does the design propose any array/list columns to store multiple values in a single field? If so, replace with a junction/bridge table. BLOCK on any array column proposal.

rules.description: CSV/delimited values forbidden
rules.message: CSV/delimited values are forbidden - normalize into separate rows
rules.design_check: Does the design store comma-separated or pipe-delimited values in any single column? If so, normalize into separate rows with a junction table. BLOCK on any such pattern.

rules.description: Use lookup tables instead of constraints
rules.message: Don't use CHECK constraints - create lookup tables prefixed with 'lkp_' instead (e.g., lkp_order_status)
rules.design_check: Does the design use CHECK (...IN (...)) constraints to restrict column values? If so, replace with a lkp_* lookup table referenced via FK. BLOCK on any CHECK constraint with inline value lists.

triggers.description: Trigger governance rules - triggers are discouraged

rules.description: Triggers should not be used - implement logic in application layer
rules.message: Don't use triggers - implement business logic, validations, and cascades in the application layer for maintainability and testability
rules.design_check: Does the design propose database triggers for any logic? If so, move that logic to the application service layer. BLOCK on any trigger proposal.

rules.description: Triggers must not modify other tables
rules.message: Triggers must not modify other tables - use application layer for cascades

rules.description: Triggers must not call external systems
rules.message: Triggers must not call external systems - use event-driven architecture

rules.description: Business logic must not live in procedures
rules.message: Business logic must not live in stored procedures - use application layer
rules.design_check: Does the design place business logic (workflow, approval, state machine, validation) in stored procedures? If so, move to application service layer. BLOCK.

rules.description: Dynamic SQL is forbidden
rules.message: Dynamic SQL is forbidden - use parameterized queries
rules.design_check: Does the design mention dynamic SQL construction? If so, replace with parameterized queries or ORM. BLOCK.

rules.description: Functions must not mutate data
rules.message: Functions must not mutate data - use procedures or application layer

rules.description: Declare function volatility explicitly
rules.message: Declare function volatility explicitly (IMMUTABLE, STABLE, or VOLATILE)

rules.description: Avoid SELECT * in production code
rules.message: Avoid SELECT * - explicitly list needed columns for better performance
rules.design_check: Does the design mention SELECT * or fetching all columns? If so, specify explicit column projections. Flag for discussion.

rules.description: Avoid N+1 query patterns
rules.message: Potential N+1 query - use batch fetching, JOINs, or eager loading
rules.design_check: Does the design involve fetching a list and then querying related data per item in a loop? If so, propose batch fetching or JOINs to avoid N+1. Flag for discussion.

rules.description: Don't use SA/admin database accounts for applications
rules.message: CRITICAL: Don't use SA/admin accounts (sa, postgres, root) - create dedicated application service accounts with minimal privileges
rules.design_check: Does the design specify which database account services will use? Ensure dedicated service accounts (not postgres/root/admin) are specified with least-privilege. BLOCK on any mention of superuser accounts for app services.

rules.description: Prevent SQL injection with parameterized queries
rules.message: CRITICAL: Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection
rules.design_check: Does the design specify parameterized queries or ORM usage for all database interactions? Flag any design that mentions string-concatenated SQL. BLOCK.

rules.description: AI should not perform destructive operations
rules.message: AI agents must not perform destructive operations without explicit approval
rules.design_check: Does the design include any DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, or DELETE without WHERE clause operations? If so, flag for explicit user approval. BLOCK on unguarded destructive operations.
